conviction_note: No consensus, no options, no company guide beyond 'runway into 2H27'; the name moves 4-9% on its prints (Nov-2025 -7.2%, Mar-2026 +9.3%, May-2026 -7.7%, Aug-2026 +4.1% close-to-close on the print day) and this release adds an unscheduled 'strategy' update of unknown content, so abs_move 9; p_up 46 leans slightly down on a now-effective in-the-money EIB resale overhang (769k ADSs, warrants at ~$1.97/ADS vs $2.65 spot) and continued ATM use, with the strategy update deliberately left near-zero in sign. The sum of findings (-1.5) and the scaled number (-0.72) agree in sign; the gap is the strategy update's two-sided range, which the scaled number carries as width, not direction.
bar: unsourced. No meaningful consensus EPS or revenue exists (Earnings Whispers preview 2026-11-11, https://finviz.com/news/421182/evaxions-q3-report-puts-cash-runway-and-post-esmo-partnering-hopes-to-the-test: 'no meaningful consensus figure and no management guidance'); Quiver cited a -$0.32 estimate for Q2 that the company missed at -$0.50 (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/EVAXION+BIOTECH+%28%24EVAX%29+Releases+Q2+2026+Earnings). The operative bars are company statements: net loss ~$3.7M/quarter (Q2 2026 $3.7M, Q1 $3.6M) and cash runway 'into second half of 2027' (Q2 MD&A, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828253/000117184326005671/ex_1006845.htm). Every finding is capped small for this reason.
positioning_check: No options market (baseline options.status no_options_market), so no skew. Short interest: no current figure found; the latest dated FINRA-derived reading found was 58,172 shares, 1.41 days to cover, settlement 2026-03-13 (https://equibles.com/stocks/evax/shortinterest), ChartExchange 67,935 shares / 1.33% on 2026-01-30 (https://chartexchange.com/symbol/nasdaq-evax/short-interest); Nasdaq's short-interest API returned 503. Not a crowded short on the data available. Tape: spot $2.65, at the 52-week low, -28.6% over 20 days and -8.9% over 5, i.e. the full ESMO pop (2.83 on 10-16 to 4.05 on 10-20) has round-tripped; 20d ADV ~77k ADSs, market cap ~ $24M (9.02M ADSs at 9/30 + 201k sold in October, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828253/000117184326007427/f424b3_111326.htm). Earnings Whispers noted retail sentiment turning 'strongly bullish' while the stock fell.

findings.finding: Evaxion's 18 Nov 6-K announcing the print says it will 'provide a STRATEGY and business update and report its third quarter 2026 financial results' before the Nasdaq open on 19 Nov, with a call at 8:30 ET; the equivalent notice for Q2 (6-K of 14 Aug 2026) said only 'business update and second quarter 2026 financial results', so a strategic change of undisclosed content is coming at a company with ~$12M cash, a ~$4.2M quarterly burn, no revenue, and a year of unconsummated 'parallel partnership discussions'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior strategy update to compare. The last pipeline/strategy re-focus (EVX-05 added, EVX-03 dropped, 17 Aug 2026) preceded a print-day move of +4.1% on 20 Aug; the October ESMO data pop (+43% over two sessions) fully reversed within a month, so this holder base has not held gains on pipeline news.
findings.why_not_priced: The word change was filed at 08:35 ET on the day before the print in a notice that wire services carry as a routine scheduling item; no preview (the Earnings Whispers piece is dated 11 Nov) mentions a strategy update. If the market had read it as a restructuring or strategic-review signal, the 18 Nov tape would show more than a 3.6% drop on 75k ADSs, roughly the 20-day average volume.
findings.independence: Comparison document: the Q2 notice, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828253/000117184326005527/f6k_073026.htm (title 'Evaxion to announce business update and second quarter 2026 financial results on August 20, 2026'). Sign is my inference only: no source says what the strategy is.

findings.finding: The F-1 registering EIB's resale of 769,000 ADSs (38.45M ordinary shares) from the 2025 debt-for-warrants settlement went effective (EFFECT filed 13 Nov, accepted 16 Nov; final 424B3 13 Nov); the warrants are exercisable now at DKK 0.25 per ordinary share = DKK 12.50 (~$1.97) per ADS against a $2.65 spot, so they are in the money, and the 769k ADSs equal ~8% of ADSs outstanding and ~10 days of the 77k-ADS 20-day average volume, with no resale volume limit in the prospectus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior EIB resale window to compare. Since the F-1/A was filed on 9 Nov the stock went 3.00 (6 Nov) to 2.68 (18 Nov), -11%, on unremarkable volume; the 20 Aug print-day move came while the company itself was selling 681k ADSs through the ATM (19-21 Aug, 6.4M and 3.6M share volume days).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -8.9% over 5 days and at the 52-week low. The wire copy (Finviz/Biopharmawatch, 9 Nov) framed the filing as 'no capital raise' and quoted the $4.87/ADS 'effective conversion price', which reads as out of the money; the actual DKK 0.25 exercise price per ordinary share, which puts the warrants ~35% in the money, is only in the prospectus body. If the market had priced a willing seller of 10 days' volume it would not need to wait for the print, so residual pressure into a liquidity event (print-day volume) is the mechanism.
findings.independence: Effectiveness from the EDGAR submissions index, https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001828253.json (EFFECT 9999999995-26-003538). The 'no capital raise / $4.87 per ADS' framing is in https://finviz.com/news/418999/evaxion-files-amendment-to-registration-statement-related-to-2025-eib-debt-settlement-agreement. Same prospectus as the ATM finding below; different fact.

findings.finding: The 424B3 discloses the company kept selling through its JonesTrading ATM into the ESMO pop: 201,198 ADSs on 19-21 Oct 2026 for ~$0.8M gross (~$3.98/ADS), after 681,268 ADSs on 19-21 Aug for ~$2.1M net; walking Q2's $14.0M cash forward by the Aug ATM and a ~$4.2M quarterly burn gives ~$11.9M at 30 Sep, ~$12.7M with October's sale, about three quarters of burn, which leaves the 'into 2H27' runway claim intact only at the margin and implies more ATM use.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The runway line has been reaffirmed unchanged on four consecutive calls (Earnings Whispers preview); the stock moved -7.7% and +4.1% on the last two of those prints, neither attributable to runway. Q2's MD&A showed $8.3M operating cash burn in H1 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: The October sale is not in any wire release; the preview (11 Nov) says ATM amounts were not disclosed. Mostly priced in sign, since the Q3 cash figure is close to mechanical, so it lands inside what the company has already guided; the residual is whether the runway statement is shortened or tied to further ATM use. What the money buys: runway for preclinical EVX-04/05 work, with no revenue ramp to fund, so it is neither a growth signal nor a distress one.
findings.independence: Q2 cash and burn from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828253/000117184326005671/ex_1006845.htm; the burn estimate agrees with the Earnings Whispers preview (~$4M/quarter, ~$10M before capital raised). Shares the 424B3 with the EIB finding.

findings.finding: Pipeline news in the window is preclinical and small: initial experimental data from the autoimmune programs (tolerogenic vaccine and autoantibody binder concepts) were due at PEGS Europe, Lisbon, on 18 Nov 2026, and the company has promised an EVX-04 (AML) regulatory filing 'before the end of 2026', which the Q3 release can confirm or slip; the EVX-01 three-year and SITC biomarker data are already out and round-tripped.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ESMO EVX-01 release (19 Oct) bought +43% over two sessions and gave all of it back by mid-November; the SITC data on 6 Nov came with a -8.3% session (3.00 to 2.75 on 9 Nov).
findings.why_not_priced: The PEGS data had no coverage found as of 18 Nov; preclinical autoimmune data rarely move a stock, so it is sized near zero. The EVX-04 filing timing is a stated milestone the call will re-state; a slip would be a small negative, an on-time confirmation is priced.
findings.independence: EVX-04 timing restated in the 424B3 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828253/000117184326007427/f424b3_111326.htm) and Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/384033/evaxion-announces-business-update-and-second-quarter-2026-financial-results).

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative in the same direction as the -28.6% 20-day run-up and the 52-week low, so much of the overhang is likely in the price; the one item that could break the pattern either way is the unannounced strategy update, which is why abs_move is set above the name's median print reaction while p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (unsourced bar): every finding capped small; the EIB overhang trimmed from -1.5 to -1.2 because I cannot say what the market expects from the print itself.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): asked what the ATM money buys (runway for preclinical work, no ramp), so the ATM/cash finding was cut from -0.5 to -0.3 as landing inside the guided runway.
Rule 5 (inference is sized small): the strategy-update sign rests on my inference about cash-constrained microcaps, so it was cut from -0.5 to -0.3 with its wide range kept.
'Asking what the market missed generates pessimism': three of four findings were negative, so p_up moved from 45 to 46; abs_move left at 9 (rule 8: understatement is the systematic error).
